translations.idiomatic: When Dezong ascended the throne she was invested as Cultivated Consort.

sentences.zh: 貞元二年，妃病。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan the consort fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 2 the consort fell ill.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，冊為皇后，是日崩於兩儀殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the eleventh month she was invested as empress; that same day she died in Liangyi Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the eleventh month she was invested as empress; that same day she died in Liangyi Hall.

sentences.zh: 臨畢，素服視事。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete he attended to affairs in plain robes.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete he attended to affairs in plain robes.

sentences.zh: 既大殮成服，百僚服三日而釋，用晉文明后崩天下發哀三日止之義，上服凡七日而釋。

translations.literal: After the great encoffining and mourning garments were complete, the hundred officials mourned three days and then were released; following the meaning of Jin's Empress Wenming, when the empress died the realm mourned three days and stopped; the emperor mourned seven days in all and then was released.
translations.idiomatic: After the great encoffining and mourning garments were complete, the hundred officials mourned three days and then were released; following Jin's Empress Wenming, when the empress died the realm mourned three days and stopped; the emperor mourned seven days in all and then was released.

sentences.zh: 諡曰昭德。

translations.literal: Her posthumous title was Zhaode.
translations.idiomatic: Her posthumous title was Zhaode.

sentences.zh: 初，令兵部侍郎李紓撰諡冊，文既進，帝以紓文謂皇后曰「大行皇后」非禮，留中不出。

translations.literal: At first the emperor ordered Vice Minister of War Li Shu to compose the posthumous investiture text; when the text was submitted, the emperor considered that Shu's text calling the empress 'the late empress' was contrary to rite and kept it within the palace without issuing it.
translations.idiomatic: At first the emperor ordered Vice Minister of War Li Shu to compose the posthumous investiture text; when the text was submitted, the emperor considered that Shu's text calling the empress 'the late empress' was contrary to rite and kept it within the palace without issuing it.

sentences.zh: 詔翰林學士吳通玄為之，通玄又雲「咨後王氏」，議者亦以為非。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Hanlin Academician Wu Tongxuan to compose it; Tongxuan again wrote 'Consult Empress Wang,' and critics also considered this wrong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Hanlin Academician Wu Tongxuan to compose it; Tongxuan again wrote 'Consult Empress Wang,' and critics also considered this wrong.

sentences.zh: 知禮者以貞觀中岑文本撰文德皇后諡冊曰「皇后長孫氏」，斯得之矣。

translations.literal: Those who knew rites cited that in Zhenguan Cen Wenben composed Empress Wende's posthumous investiture as 'Empress Lady Changsun'—that was correct.
translations.idiomatic: Those who knew rites cited that in Zhenguan Cen Wenben composed Empress Wende's posthumous investiture as 'Empress Lady Changsun'—that was correct.

sentences.zh: 五月，葬於靖陵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month she was buried at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month she was buried at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 后母郕國夫人鄭氏請設祭，詔曰：「祭筵不可用假花果，欲祭者從之。」

translations.literal: The empress's mother, Lady of Zheng, requested to set up sacrifices; an edict proclaimed: "Sacrificial tables may not use artificial flowers and fruit; those who wish to sacrifice may do so."
translations.idiomatic: The empress's mother, Lady of Zheng, requested to set up sacrifices; an edict proclaimed, "Sacrificial tables may not use artificial flowers and fruit; those who wish to sacrifice may do so."

sentences.zh: 自是宗室諸親，及李晟、渾瑊、神策六軍大將皆設祭。

translations.literal: From then on the imperial clan and kin, and Li Sheng, Hun Jian, and the great generals of the six armies of the Divine Strategy Army all set up sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the imperial clan and kin, and Li Sheng, Hun Jian, and the great generals of the six armies of the Divine Strategy Army all set up sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 自啟攢後，日數祭，至發引方止。

translations.literal: From the time the temporary coffin was opened, sacrifices were offered daily until the procession departed and only then stopped.
translations.idiomatic: From the time the temporary coffin was opened, sacrifices were offered daily until the procession departed and only then stopped.

sentences.zh: 宰臣韓滉為哀冊。

translations.literal: Chancellor Han Huang composed the lamentation investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Han Huang composed the lamentation investiture.

sentences.zh: 又命宰相張延賞、柳渾撰《昭德皇后廟樂章》，既進，上以詞句非工，留中不下，令學士吳通玄別撰進。

translations.literal: The emperor also ordered Chancellors Zhang Yanshang and Liu Hun to compose the 'Hymns of Empress Zhaode's Temple'; when submitted, the emperor considered the wording not skilled and kept them within the palace without issuing them, ordering Academician Wu Tongxuan to compose and submit another version.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also ordered Chancellors Zhang Yanshang and Liu Hun to compose the 'Hymns of Empress Zhaode's Temple'; when submitted, the emperor considered the wording not skilled and kept them within the palace without issuing them, ordering Academician Wu Tongxuan to compose and submit another version.

sentences.zh: 初，后為淑妃，德宗贈后父遇揚州大都督，遇子果眉州司馬，甥侄拜官者二十餘人。

translations.literal: At first, when she was Cultivated Consort, Dezong posthumously honored the empress's father Yu as Grand Protector of Yangzhou; Yu's son Guo, prefectural aide in Meizhou, and nephews and nieces received office—more than twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when she was Cultivated Consort, Dezong posthumously honored her father Yu as Grand Protector of Yangzhou; Yu's son Guo, prefectural aide in Meizhou, and nephews and nieces received office—more than twenty persons.

sentences.zh: 永貞元年十一月，徙靖陵，祔葬於崇陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the first year of Yongzhen, Jingling was moved and she was enshrined and buried at Chongling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Yongzhen 1, Jingling was moved and she was enshrined and buried at Chongling.

sentences.zh: 德宗韋賢妃，不知氏族所出，初為良娣，貞元二年，冊為賢妃。

translations.literal: Virtuous Consort Wei of Emperor Dezong; her clan and surname are unknown; at first she was Worthy Consort; in the second year of Zhenyuan she was invested as Virtuous Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Virtuous Consort Wei of Dezong; her clan and surname are unknown; at first she was Worthy Consort; in Zhenyuan 2 she was invested as Virtuous Consort.

sentences.zh: 性敏惠，言無苟容，動必由禮，德宗深重之，六宮師其德行。

translations.literal: Her nature was keen and gracious; her words were never careless; her movements always followed rite; Dezong valued her deeply, and the six palaces took her conduct as model.
translations.idiomatic: Her nature was keen and gracious; her words were never careless; her movements always followed rite; Dezong valued her deeply, and the six palaces took her conduct as model.

sentences.zh: 及德宗崩，請於崇陵終喪紀，因侍於寢園。

translations.literal: When Dezong died she requested to complete mourning at Chongling and therefore attended the tomb garden.
translations.idiomatic: When Dezong died she requested to complete mourning at Chongling and therefore attended the tomb garden.

sentences.zh: 元和四年薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanhe she died.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 4 she died.

sentences.zh: 順宗莊憲皇后王氏，琅邪人。

translations.literal: Empress Zhuangxian of Emperor Shunzong, née Wang, was a native of Langya.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zhuangxian of Shunzong, née Wang, came from Langya.

sentences.zh: 曾祖思敬，試太子賓客；

translations.literal: Her great-grandfather Sijing was Acting Companion to the Crown Prince;
translations.idiomatic: Her great-grandfather Sijing was Acting Companion to the Crown Prince;

sentences.zh: 祖難得，贈潞州都督，封琅邪郡公；

translations.literal: her grandfather Nande was posthumously honored as military governor of Luzhou and enfeoffed as Duke of Langya;
translations.idiomatic: her grandfather Nande was posthumously honored as military governor of Luz Prefecture and enfeoffed Duke of Langya;

sentences.zh: 父顏，金紫光祿大夫、衛尉卿。

translations.literal: her father Yan was Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Cord and Commandant of the Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: her father Yan was Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Cord and Commandant of the Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 后幼以良家子選入宮為才人，順宗在籓時，代宗以才人賜之，時年十三。

translations.literal: In youth, as a woman of good family she was chosen into the palace as a talented lady; when Shunzong was in his fief Daizong gave her as a talented lady; she was then thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: In youth, as a woman of good family she was chosen into the palace as a talented lady; when Shunzong was in his fief Daizong gave her as a talented lady; she was then thirteen.

sentences.zh: 大曆十三年，生憲宗皇帝，立為宣王孺人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Dali she bore Emperor Xianzong and was established as Lady of the Prince of Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Dali 13 she bore Emperor Xianzong and was established as Lady of the Prince of Xuan.

sentences.zh: 順宗升儲，冊為良娣。

translations.literal: When Shunzong was elevated as heir apparent she was invested as Worthy Consort.
translations.idiomatic: When Shunzong was elevated as heir apparent she was invested as Worthy Consort.

sentences.zh: 后言容恭謹，宮中稱其德行。

translations.literal: The empress's words and bearing were respectful and careful; within the palace they praised her conduct.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's words and bearing were respectful and careful; within the palace they praised her conduct.

sentences.zh: 順宗即位，疾恙未平，后供侍醫藥，不離左右。

translations.literal: When Shunzong ascended the throne his illness was not yet settled; the empress attended and supplied medicine and did not leave his side.
translations.idiomatic: When Shunzong ascended the throne his illness was not yet settled; the empress attended and supplied medicine and did not leave his side.

sentences.zh: 屬帝不能言，冊禮將行復止。

translations.literal: Since the emperor could not speak, the investiture rite was about to proceed but was again halted.
translations.idiomatic: Since the emperor could not speak, the investiture rite was about to proceed but was again halted.

sentences.zh: 及永貞內禪，冊為太上皇后。

translations.literal: At the inner abdication of Yongzhen she was invested as Grand Empress.
translations.idiomatic: At the inner abdication of Yongzhen she was invested as Grand Empress.

sentences.zh: 元和元年正月，順宗晏駕，五月，尊太上皇后為皇太后，冊禮畢，憲宗御紫宸殿宣赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanhe Shunzong died; in the fifth month the Grand Empress was honored as empress dowager; when the investiture rite was complete Xianzong proclaimed amnesty from the Zichen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanhe 1 Shunzong died; in the fifth month the Grand Empress was honored as empress dowager; when the investiture rite was complete Xianzong proclaimed amnesty from the Zichen Hall.

sentences.zh: 太后居興慶宮。

translations.literal: The empress dowager resided at Xingqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager resided at Xingqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 后性仁和恭遜，深抑外戚，無絲毫假貸，訓厲內職，有母儀之風焉。

translations.literal: The empress's nature was benevolent, harmonious, and deferential; she deeply restrained the maternal kin and granted not the slightest indulgence; she instructed inner offices and had the bearing of a mother to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's nature was benevolent, harmonious, and deferential; she deeply restrained the maternal kin and granted not the slightest indulgence; she instructed inner offices and had the bearing of a mother to the realm.

sentences.zh: 元和十一年三月，崩于南內之咸寧殿，諡曰莊憲皇后。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year of Yuanhe she died in Xianning Hall of the Southern Inner Palace; her posthumous title was Empress Zhuangxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Yuanhe 11 she died in Xianning Hall of the Southern Inner Palace; her posthumous title was Empress Zhuangxian.

sentences.zh: 初，太常少卿韋纁進諡議，公卿署定，欲告天地宗廟。

translations.literal: At first Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wei Xi submitted the posthumous deliberation; the high ministers signed and fixed it, intending to report to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: At first Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wei Xi submitted the posthumous deliberation; the high ministers signed and fixed it, intending to report to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 禮院奏議曰：「謹按《曾子問》：『賤不誄貴，幼不誄長，禮也。』

translations.literal: The Office of Rites memorialized: "We respectfully consult the Zengzi Questions: 'The base do not eulogize the noble; the young do not eulogize the elder—this is rite.'
translations.idiomatic: The Office of Rites memorialized, "We respectfully consult the Zengzi Questions: 'The base do not eulogize the noble; the young do not eulogize the elder—this is rite.'

sentences.zh: 古者天子稱天以誄之，皇后之諡，則讀於廟。

translations.literal: In antiquity the Son of Heaven proclaimed Heaven to eulogize; the empress's posthumous title was then read in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the Son of Heaven proclaimed Heaven to eulogize; the empress's posthumous title was then read in the temple.

sentences.zh: 《江都集禮》引《白虎通》曰：『皇后何所諡之，以為於廟。』

translations.literal: The Collected Rites of Jiangdu cites the White Tiger Discourse: 'Where is the empress eulogized? It is considered to be in the temple.'
translations.idiomatic: The Collected Rites of Jiangdu cites the White Tiger Discourse: 'Where is the empress eulogized? It is considered to be in the temple.'

sentences.zh: 又曰：『皇后無外事，無為於郊。』

translations.literal: It also says: 'The empress has no outer affairs and does not act at the suburban altars.'
translations.idiomatic: It also says: 'The empress has no outer affairs and does not act at the suburban altars.'

sentences.zh: 《傳》曰：『故雖天子，必有尊也。』

translations.literal: The Commentary says: 'Therefore even the Son of Heaven must have one he honors.'
translations.idiomatic: The Commentary says: 'Therefore even the Son of Heaven must have one he honors.'

sentences.zh: 准禮，賤不得誄貴，子不得爵母。

translations.literal: According to rite, the base may not eulogize the noble; the son may not ennoble the mother.
translations.idiomatic: According to rite, the base may not eulogize the noble; the son may not ennoble the mother.

sentences.zh: 所以必諡於廟者，諡宜受成於祖宗；

translations.literal: The reason the eulogy must be in the temple is that the posthumous title should receive completion from the ancestors;
translations.idiomatic: The reason the eulogy must be in the temple is that the posthumous title should receive completion from the ancestors;

sentences.zh: 故天子諡成于郊，后妃諡成於廟。

translations.literal: therefore the Son of Heaven's posthumous title is completed at the suburban altar, and the consort's posthumous title is completed in the temple.
translations.idiomatic: therefore the Son of Heaven's posthumous title is completed at the suburban altar, and the consort's posthumous title is completed in the temple.

sentences.zh: 今請准禮，集百官連署諡狀訖，讀於太廟，然後上諡於兩儀殿。

sentences.zh: 后生福王綰，漢陽、雲安、遂安三公主。

translations.literal: The empress bore Prince of Fu, Wan, and the three princesses Hanyang, Yun'an, and Suian.
translations.idiomatic: The empress bore Prince Wan of Fu and the three princesses Hanyang, Yun'an, and Suian.

sentences.zh: 后之祖、父、母、弟見《外戚傳》。

translations.literal: The empress's grandfather, father, mother, and younger brother appear in the Biographies of Outer Relatives.
translations.idiomatic: The empress's grandfather, father, mother, and younger brother appear in the Biographies of Outer Relatives.

sentences.zh: 憲宗懿安皇后郭氏，尚父子儀之孫，贈左僕射、駙馬都尉曖之女。

translations.literal: Empress Yian of Emperor Xianzong was the granddaughter of Guo Ziyi, the honored son-in-law; daughter of the posthumously honored Left Vice Director and Chief Commandant of the Empress's Household Ai.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Yian of Xianzong was the granddaughter of Guo Ziyi, the honored son-in-law; daughter of the posthumously honored Left Vice Director and Chief Commandant of the Empress's Household Ai.

sentences.zh: 母代宗長女升平公主。

translations.literal: Her mother was Princess Shengping, Daizong's eldest daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Her mother was Princess Shengping, Daizong's eldest daughter.

sentences.zh: 憲宗為廣陵王時，納后為妃。

translations.literal: When Xianzong was Prince of Guangling he took the empress as consort.
translations.idiomatic: When Xianzong was Prince of Guangling he took her as consort.

sentences.zh: 以母貴，父、祖有大勳於王室，順宗深寵異之。

translations.literal: Because her mother was honored and her father and grandfather had great merit for the royal house, Shunzong deeply favored her.
translations.idiomatic: Because her mother was honored and her father and grandfather had great merit for the royal house, Shunzong deeply favored her.

sentences.zh: 貞元十一年，生穆宗皇帝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhenyuan she bore Emperor Muzong.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 11 she bore Emperor Muzong.

sentences.zh: 元和元年八月，冊為貴妃。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the first year of Yuanhe she was invested as Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Yuanhe 1 she was invested as Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 八年十二月，百僚拜表請立貴妃為皇后，凡三上章。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eighth year the hundred officials submitted memorials requesting that the Noble Consort be established as empress; altogether three memorials were submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Yuanhe 8 the hundred officials submitted memorials requesting that the Noble Consort be established as empress; altogether three memorials were submitted.

sentences.zh: 上以歲暮，來年有子午之忌，且止。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the year was ending, stopped for the taboo of the zi and wu years in the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, because the year was ending, stopped for the taboo of the zi and wu years in the coming year.

sentences.zh: 帝後庭多私愛，以后門族華盛，慮正位之後，不容嬖幸，以是冊拜後時。

translations.literal: The emperor's rear palace had many private favorites; because the empress's clan was flourishing, he feared that after the formal position was established there would be no room for favored consorts—therefore investiture came late.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's rear palace had many private favorites; because her clan was flourishing, he feared that after the formal position was established there would be no room for favored consorts—therefore investiture came late.

sentences.zh: 「嗣皇帝臣名再拜言：伏以正坤元，母天下，符至德以升大號，因晉運而飾鴻徽，煥乎前聞，焯彼古訓，以極尊尊親親之義，明因天事地之經，有自來矣。

translations.literal: "The succeeding emperor, your subject [Name], bowing twice, says: We respectfully consider that to set right the feminine norm and be mother to all under Heaven, to accord with utmost virtue in raising a great title and, through Jin's fortune, to adorn a splendid emblem—how it shines in former reports and illuminates those ancient instructions, to the utmost of honoring the honored and cherishing the near, and to clarify the canon of serving Heaven and honoring Earth—has been so from of old.

sentences.zh: 伏惟大行皇帝貴妃，大虹毓慶，霽月披祥，導靈派於昭回，揖殊仁於氣母，範圍百行，表飭六宮，粵在中闈，流宣陰教，輔佐先聖，勤勞庶工。

translations.literal: We respectfully consider that the late emperor's Noble Consort, the great rainbow gathered blessing, the clearing moon spread auspice, drew the numinous line from the circling heavens and received extraordinary benevolence from the mother of qi; her pattern encompassed the hundred conduct and displayed adornment to the six palaces; within the inner quarters she spread the feminine teaching, assisted the former sage, and labored diligently among the multitude.

sentences.zh: 顧以沖眇，遭罹閔凶，荷成命於守器之時，奉寶圖於鑄鼎之日，哀纏易月，痛钜終天。

translations.literal: We, small and unworthy, encountered grievous bereavement, received the completed mandate in the time of guarding the vessel, and received the precious chart on the day of casting the tripod; grief wound through the month of changing garments, pain filled the end of Heaven.

translations.idiomatic: Yet the four seas were without alarm and the ten thousand states were ordered; looking up to the grace of nurturing, we dare raise the wind of sage goodness, and respectfully submit the honored title Empress Dowager."

sentences.zh: 是日，百僚稱慶，外命婦奉賀光順門。

translations.literal: That day the hundred officials offered congratulations; outer-court ladies offered felicitations at Guangshun Gate.
translations.idiomatic: That day the hundred officials offered congratulations; outer-court ladies offered felicitations at Guangshun Gate.

sentences.zh: 詔皇太后曾祖贈太保，追封岐國公敬之，贈太傅，太后父駙馬都尉曖贈太尉，母虢國大長公主贈齊國大長公主，后兄司農卿釗為刑部尚書、鏦為金吾大將軍。

sentences.zh: 太后居興慶宮，帝每月朔望參拜，三朝慶賀，帝自率百官詣門上壽。

translations.literal: The empress dowager resided at Xingqing Palace; the emperor on the first and fifteenth of each month paid respects; on the three festival celebrations of court he personally led the hundred officials to the gate to offer longevity wishes.

translations.literal: When fine days and beautiful scenes arrived, the six palaces' ladies, kin of the imperial consorts, and relatives—the chariots and horses crowded the Southern Inner Palace, and the sound of carriage bells and pendants rang like the ninefold performance.
translations.idiomatic: When fine days and beautiful scenes arrived, the six palaces' ladies, kin of the imperial consorts, and relatives—the chariots and horses crowded the Southern Inner Palace, and the sound of carriage bells and pendants rang like the ninefold performance.

translations.idiomatic: Muzong's intent was quite extravagant and unrestrained; morning and evening supplies were especially lavish and splendid.

translations.literal: The empress dowager once visited Mount Li and ascended Shiweng Temple; the emperor ordered Prince of Jing to lead the imperial guard in attendance; the emperor himself went from Zhaoying to welcome her; they traveled for pleasure several days before returning.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager once visited Mount Li and ascended Shiweng Temple; the emperor ordered Prince of Jing to lead the imperial guard in attendance; the emperor himself went from Zhaoying to welcome her; they traveled for pleasure several days before returning.

sentences.zh: 敬宗即位，尊為太皇太后。

translations.literal: When Jingzong ascended the throne she was honored as grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingzong ascended the throne she was honored as grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 及寶曆季年，凶徒竊發，昭湣暴殞，內外震駭。

translations.literal: In the last year of Baoli, wicked men secretly rose; Emperor Zhaomin died violently; inner and outer were shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the last year of Baoli, wicked men secretly rose; Emperor Zhaomin died violently; inner and outer were shaken.

sentences.zh: 宦官迎絳王監國，尋又加害。

translations.literal: The eunuchs welcomed Prince of Jiang to supervise the state; soon they added injury.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuchs welcomed Prince of Jiang to supervise the state; soon they added injury.

translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager issued an order, "The late emperor was wise and capable in many ways, responding to Heaven's mandate; he should have borne the weight of the nine temples and forever enjoyed the throne of ten thousand years.

translations.literal: Who would have thought treacherous villains would secretly rise, falsely seizing the sacred vessel, deluding inner and outer, inciting the feelings of the multitude, shocking gods and men, and offense deep as the owl mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Who would have thought treacherous villains would secretly rise, falsely seizing the sacred vessel, deluding inner and outer, inciting the feelings of the multitude, shocking gods and men, and offense deep as the owl mirror.

translations.literal: Wenzong was filial and modestly careful, serving his grandmother with rite.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong was filial and modestly careful, serving his grandmother with rite.

sentences.zh: 膳羞珍果，蠻夷奇貢，獻郊廟之後，及三宮而後進禦。

translations.literal: Fine foods, precious fruits, and exotic tribute from barbarian lands—after presentation at the suburban altars and temples, they were then sent to the three palaces before being forwarded for the emperor's table.
translations.idiomatic: Fine foods, precious fruits, and exotic tribute from barbarian lands—after presentation at the suburban altars and temples, they were then sent to the three palaces before being forwarded for the emperor's table.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，以后祖母之尊，門地素貴，奉之益隆。

translations.literal: When Wuzong ascended the throne, because of the empress dowager's rank as grandmother and her family's long-standing nobility, she was served with ever greater honor.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzong ascended the throne, because of the empress dowager's rank as grandmother and her family's long-standing nobility, she was served with ever greater honor.

sentences.zh: 既而宣宗繼統，即后之諸子也，恩禮愈異於前朝。

translations.literal: Soon Xuanzong succeeded to the line; he was the empress dowager's own son; grace and rite were ever more unlike the former court.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Xuanzong succeeded to the line; he was the empress dowager's own son; grace and rite were ever more unlike the former court.

sentences.zh: 大中年崩于興慶宮，諡曰懿安皇太后，祔葬于景陵。

translations.literal: In the Dazhong era she died at Xingqing Palace; her posthumous title was Grand Empress Dowager Yian; she was enshrined and buried at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dazhong era she died at Xingqing Palace; her posthumous title was Grand Empress Dowager Yian; she was enshrined and buried at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 后歷位七朝，五居太母之尊，人君行子孫之禮，福壽隆貴，四十餘年，雖漢之馬、鄧，無以加焉。

translations.literal: The empress dowager passed through seven reigns and five times held the honor of great mother; emperors performed the rites of sons and grandsons; fortune, longevity, eminence, and honor—for more than forty years—even the Ma and Deng of Han could not surpass her.

sentences.zh: 識者以為汾陽社稷之功未泯，復鐘慶于懿安焉。

translations.idiomatic: Those who understood the times thought that Fenyang's merit for the altars had not yet faded, and blessing again gathered on Yian.

translations.idiomatic: Empress Xiaoming of Xianzong, née Zheng, was Xuanzong's mother.

sentences.zh: 蓋內職禦女之列，舊史殘缺，未見族姓所出、入宮之由。

translations.idiomatic: She was among the inner offices' imperial women; the old histories are fragmentary and do not show her clan's surname or the reason for entering the palace.

sentences.zh: 宣宗為光王時，后為王太妃。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong was Prince of Guang he was the prince's grand consort.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanzong was Prince of Guang he was the prince's grand consort.

sentences.zh: 既即位，尊為皇太后。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne she was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: When he ascended the throne she was honored as empress dowager.

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Huichang the empress dowager's younger brother Guang dreamed that a carriage carried the sun and moon, their light illuminating the six directions; the diviner said: "He will suddenly rise to high rank."
translations.idiomatic: In Huichang 6 the empress dowager's younger brother Guang dreamed that a carriage carried the sun and moon, their light illuminating the six directions; the diviner said, "He will suddenly rise to high rank."

translations.literal: After a little more than a month Wuzong died and Xuanzong ascended the throne; Guang, by rank as maternal uncle, was made Acting Minister of Revenue and General of the Guards, and sent out as military governor of Pinglu.
translations.idiomatic: After a little more than a month Wuzong died and Xuanzong ascended the throne; Guang, by rank as maternal uncle, was made Acting Minister of Revenue and General of the Guards, and sent out as military governor of Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 后大中末崩，諡曰孝明。

translations.literal: The empress dowager died at the end of Dazhong; her posthumous title was Xiaoming.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager died at the end of Dazhong; her posthumous title was Xiaoming.

sentences.zh: 女學士、尚宮宋氏者，名若昭，貝州清陽人。

translations.literal: The female academician and Chief of the Inner Palace, Lady Song, named Ruozhao, was a native of Qingyang in Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The female academician and Chief of the Inner Palace, Lady Song, named Ruozhao, came from Qingyang in Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 父庭芬，世為儒學，至庭芬有詞藻。

translations.literal: Her father Tingfen for generations studied Confucian learning; by Tingfen's time he had literary talent.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Tingfen's family for generations studied Confucian learning; by Tingfen's time he had literary talent.

sentences.zh: 生五女，皆聰惠，庭芬始教以經藝，既而課為詩賦，年未及笄，皆能屬文。

translations.literal: He had five daughters, all clever; Tingfen first taught them the classics and rites, then set them to compose poetry and rhapsodies; before they reached hairpin age all could write prose.
translations.idiomatic: He had five daughters, all clever; Tingfen first taught them the classics and rites, then set them to compose poetry and rhapsodies; before they reached hairpin age all could write prose.

sentences.zh: 長曰若莘，次曰若昭、若倫、若憲、若荀。

translations.literal: The eldest was Ruoxin; next Ruozhao, Ruolun, Ruoxian, and Ruoxun.
translations.idiomatic: The eldest was Ruoxin; next Ruozhao, Ruolun, Ruoxian, and Ruoxun.

sentences.zh: 若莘、若昭文尤淡麗，性復貞素閒雅，不尚紛華之飾。

translations.literal: Ruoxin and Ruozhao were especially refined and elegant in writing, and by nature chaste, plain, and graceful, not fond of ornate adornment.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoxin and Ruozhao were especially refined and elegant in writing, and by nature chaste, plain, and graceful, not fond of ornate adornment.

sentences.zh: 嘗白父母，誓不從人，願以藝學揚名顯親。

translations.literal: They once told their parents they vowed never to marry and wished through artistic learning to make their names known and honor their kin.
translations.idiomatic: They once told their parents they vowed never to marry and wished through artistic learning to make their names known and honor their kin.

sentences.zh: 若莘教誨四妹，有如嚴師。

translations.literal: Ruoxin instructed and taught her four younger sisters like a strict teacher.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoxin instructed and taught her four younger sisters like a strict teacher.

sentences.zh: 著《女論語》十篇，其言模仿《論語》，以韋逞母宣文君宋氏代仲尼，以曹大家等代顏、閔，其間問答，悉以婦道所尚。

translations.literal: She composed the 'Women's Analects' in ten chapters; its words imitate the Analects, taking Lady Song Xuanwen of Wei in place of Zhongni, and Cao the Great Elder and others in place of Yan and Min; the questions and answers between them all take what the woman's Way esteems.
translations.idiomatic: She composed the 'Women's Analects' in ten chapters; its words imitate the Analects, taking Lady Song Xuanwen of Wei in place of Zhongni, and Cao the Great Elder and others in place of Yan and Min; the questions and answers between them all take what the woman's Way esteems.

sentences.zh: 若昭注解，皆有理致。

translations.literal: Ruozhao annotated it; all had logical coherence.
translations.idiomatic: Ruozhao annotated it; all had logical coherence.

sentences.zh: 貞元四年，昭義節度使李抱真表薦以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenyuan Military Governor Li Baozhen of Zhaoyi memorialized recommending them to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenyuan 4 Military Governor Li Baozhen of Zhaoyi memorialized recommending them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 德宗俱召入宮，試以詩賦，兼問經史中大義，深加賞歎。

translations.literal: Dezong summoned them all into the palace, tested them with poetry and rhapsody, and also questioned them on great themes in the classics and histories; he deeply praised and admired them.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong summoned them all into the palace, tested them with poetry and rhapsody, and also questioned them on great themes in the classics and histories; he deeply praised and admired them.

sentences.zh: 德宗能詩，與侍臣唱和相屬，亦令若莘姊妹應制。

translations.literal: Dezong could compose poetry and exchanged verses with attendant ministers; he also ordered the Ruoxin sisters to respond to imperial composition.
translations.idiomatic: Dezong could compose poetry and exchanged verses with attendant ministers; he also ordered the Ruoxin sisters to respond to imperial composition.

sentences.zh: 每進禦，無不稱善。

translations.literal: Whenever they were presented at court none failed to be praised.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever they were presented at court none failed to be praised.

sentences.zh: 嘉其節概不群，不以宮妾遇之，呼為學士先生。

translations.literal: He admired their integrity and distinction and did not treat them as palace concubines; he called them Academician and Teacher.
translations.idiomatic: He admired their integrity and distinction and did not treat them as palace concubines; he called them Academician and Teacher.

sentences.zh: 庭芬起家受饒州司馬，習藝館內，敕賜第一區，給俸料。

translations.literal: Tingfen began his career as Prefectural Aide of Raozhou; within the Arts Practice Hall an edict bestowed the first residence and granted salary.
translations.idiomatic: Tingfen began his career as Prefectural Aide of Raozhou; within the Arts Practice Hall an edict bestowed the first residence and granted salary.

sentences.zh: 元和末，若莘卒，贈河內郡君。

translations.literal: At the end of Yuanhe Ruoxin died and was posthumously created Lady of Henei.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Yuanhe Ruoxin died and was posthumously created Lady of Henei.

sentences.zh: 自貞元七年已後，宮中記注簿籍，若莘掌其事。

translations.literal: From the seventh year of Zhenyuan onward, the palace's record books and registers were managed by Ruoxin.
translations.idiomatic: From Zhenyuan 7 onward, the palace's record books and registers were managed by Ruoxin.

sentences.zh: 穆宗復令若昭代司其職，拜尚宮。

translations.literal: Muzong again ordered Ruozhao to take over those duties in her stead and appointed her Chief of the Inner Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong again ordered Ruozhao to take over those duties in her stead and appointed her Chief of the Inner Palace.

sentences.zh: 姊妹中，若昭尤通曉人事，自憲、穆、敬三帝，皆呼為先生，六宮嬪媛、諸王、公主、駙馬皆師之，為之致敬。

translations.literal: Among the sisters Ruozhao was especially versed in human affairs; from Xianzong, Muzong, and Jingzong all called her Teacher; consorts and ladies of the six palaces, princes, princesses, and chief commandants all took her as teacher and showed her reverence.
translations.idiomatic: Among the sisters Ruozhao was especially versed in human affairs; from Xianzong, Muzong, and Jingzong all called her Teacher; consorts and ladies of the six palaces, princes, princesses, and chief commandants all took her as teacher and showed her reverence.

sentences.zh: 進封梁國夫人。

translations.literal: She was advanced and enfeoffed as Lady of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: She was advanced and enfeoffed as Lady of Liang.

sentences.zh: 寶曆初卒，將葬，詔所司供鹵簿。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoli she died; when she was to be buried an edict ordered the relevant offices to supply the imperial escort.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Baoli she died; when she was to be buried an edict ordered the relevant offices to supply the imperial escort.

sentences.zh: 敬宗復令若憲代司宮籍。

translations.literal: Jingzong again ordered Ruoxian to take over the palace registers in her stead.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzong again ordered Ruoxian to take over the palace registers in her stead.

sentences.zh: 文宗好文，以若憲善屬文，能論議奏對，尤重之。

translations.literal: Wenzong loved literature; because Ruoxian was skilled at writing prose and could debate and respond in memorials, he especially valued her.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong loved literature; because Ruoxian was skilled at writing prose and could debate and respond in memorials, he especially valued her.

sentences.zh: 大和中，神策中尉王守澄用事，委信翼城醫人鄭注、賊臣李訓，幹竊時權。

translations.literal: In the Dahe era Lieutenant of the Divine Strategy Army Wang Shoucheng held power and entrusted Yicheng physician Zheng Zhu and the wicked minister Li Xun, who usurped the power of the time.
translations.idiomatic: In the Dahe era Lieutenant of the Divine Strategy Army Wang Shoucheng held power and entrusted Yicheng physician Zheng Zhu and the wicked minister Li Xun, who usurped the power of the time.

sentences.zh: 訓、注惡宰相李宗閔、李德裕，構宗閔憸邪，為吏部侍郎時，令駙馬都尉沈㺹通賂於若憲，求為宰相。

translations.literal: Xun and Zhu hated Chancellors Li Zongmin and Li Deyu; they framed Zongmin as treacherous and wicked, saying that when he was Vice Minister of Personnel he had Commandant-escort Shen Pian send bribes to Ruoxian to seek the chancellorship.
translations.idiomatic: Xun and Zhu hated Chancellors Li Zongmin and Li Deyu; they framed Zongmin as treacherous and wicked, saying that when he was Vice Minister of Personnel he had Commandant-escort Shen Pian send bribes to Ruoxian to seek the chancellorship.

sentences.zh: 文宗怒，貶宗閔為潮州司戶，㺹柳州司馬，幽若憲於外第，賜死。

translations.literal: Wenzong was angry; Zongmin was demoted to Registrar of Chaozhou, Pian to Prefectural Aide of Liuzhou, and Ruoxian was confined in an outer residence and given death.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong was angry; Zongmin was demoted to Registrar of Chaozhou, Pian to Prefectural Aide of Liuzhou, and Ruoxian was confined in an outer residence and given death.

sentences.zh: 若憲弟侄女婿等連坐者十三人，皆流嶺表。

translations.literal: Ruoxian's younger brothers, nephews, sons-in-law, and others implicated numbered thirteen persons; all were banished to the region beyond the ranges.
translations.idiomatic: Ruoxian's younger brothers, nephews, sons-in-law, and others implicated numbered thirteen persons; all were banished to the region beyond the ranges.

sentences.zh: 李訓敗，文宗悟其誣構，深惜其才。

translations.literal: When Li Xun was defeated Wenzong realized the frame and deeply regretted her talent.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Xun was defeated Wenzong realized the frame and deeply regretted her talent.

sentences.zh: 若倫、若荀早卒。

translations.literal: Ruolun and Ruoxun died early.
translations.idiomatic: Ruolun and Ruoxun died early.

sentences.zh: 穆宗恭僖皇后王氏，越人。

translations.literal: Empress Gongxi of Emperor Muzong, née Wang, was a native of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Gongxi of Muzong, née Wang, came from Yue.

sentences.zh: 父紹卿，婺州金華令。

translations.literal: Her father Shaoqing was magistrate of Jinhua in Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Her father Shaoqing was magistrate of Jinhua in Wu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後少入太子宮，元和四年生敬宗。

translations.literal: The empress entered the crown prince's palace in youth; in the fourth year of Yuanhe she bore Jingzong.
translations.idiomatic: The empress entered the crown prince's palace in youth; in Yuanhe 4 she bore Jingzong.

sentences.zh: 穆宗皇帝立為妃。

translations.literal: Emperor Muzong established her as consort.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Muzong established her as consort.

sentences.zh: 長慶四年二月，尊為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year of Changqing she was honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Changqing 4 she was honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 昭湣崇重母族，贈紹卿司空，後母張氏贈趙國夫人。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhaomin honored the maternal clan; Shaoqing was posthumously made Minister of Works; the empress dowager's mother Lady Zhang was posthumously created Lady of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhaomin honored the maternal clan; Shaoqing was posthumously made Minister of Works; the empress dowager's mother Lady Zhang was posthumously created Lady of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 文宗即位之初，號寶曆太后。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wenzong's reign she was titled Empress Dowager of Baoli.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Wenzong's reign she was titled Empress Dowager of Baoli.

sentences.zh: 大和八年詔：「伏以皇太后與寶曆太后，每有司行遣，稱號未分，禮式非便，稽諸前代，詔令所施，不斥言太后，以宮名為稱。

translations.literal: An edict of the eighth year of Dahe proclaimed: "We respectfully consider that the empress dowager and the Empress Dowager of Baoli, whenever offices acted, their titles were not distinguished and ceremonial was inconvenient; examining former ages, in edicts and commands issued, they did not explicitly say 'empress dowager' but used the palace name as title.
translations.idiomatic: An edict of Dahe 8 proclaimed, "We respectfully consider that the empress dowager and the Empress Dowager of Baoli, whenever offices acted, their titles were not distinguished and ceremonial was inconvenient; examining former ages, in edicts and commands issued, they did not explicitly say 'empress dowager' but used the palace name as title.

sentences.zh: 今寶曆太后居義安殿，宜准故事稱義安太后。」

translations.literal: Now the Empress Dowager of Baoli resides at Yi'an Hall; she should according to precedent be called Empress Dowager of Yi'an."
translations.idiomatic: Now the Empress Dowager of Baoli resides at Yi'an Hall; she should according to precedent be called Empress Dowager of Yi'an."

sentences.zh: 敬宗郭貴妃，父義，右威衛將軍。

translations.literal: Noble Consort Guo of Jingzong; her father Yi was General of the Right Weiwu Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Noble Consort Guo of Jingzong; her father Yi was General of the Right Weiwu Guard.

sentences.zh: 長慶末，以姿貌選入太子宮。

translations.literal: At the end of Changqing she was chosen into the crown prince's palace for her beauty.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Changqing she was chosen into the crown prince's palace for her beauty.

sentences.zh: 敬宗即位，為才人，生晉王普。

translations.literal: When Jingzong ascended the throne she was a talented lady and bore Prince of Jin, Pu.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingzong ascended the throne she was a talented lady and bore Prince Pu of Jin.

sentences.zh: 帝以少年有子，復以才人容德冠絕，特寵異之。

translations.literal: Because the emperor was young and had a son, and because the talented lady's bearing and virtue topped all others, she received special favor.
translations.idiomatic: Because the emperor was young and had a son, and because the talented lady's bearing and virtue topped all others, she received special favor.

sentences.zh: 贈其父禮部尚書，又以兄環為少府少監，賜第一區。

translations.literal: Her father was posthumously made Minister of Rites; her elder brother Huan was made Vice Director of the Palace Workshops and granted a first residence.
translations.idiomatic: Her father was posthumously made Minister of Rites; her elder brother Huan was made Vice Director of the Palace Workshops and granted a first residence.

sentences.zh: 俄冊為貴妃。

translations.literal: Soon she was invested as Noble Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Soon she was invested as Noble Consort.

sentences.zh: 及昭湣遇盜，宮闈變起，文宗即位，尤憐晉王，有若己子，故貴妃禮遇不衰。

translations.literal: When Zhaomin met with assassins and turmoil rose in the palace inner quarters, Wenzong ascended the throne and especially cherished Prince of Jin as if he were his own son; therefore the Noble Consort's honor and treatment did not decline.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaomin met with assassins and turmoil rose in the palace inner quarters, Wenzong ascended the throne and especially cherished Prince of Jin as if he were his own son; therefore the Noble Consort's honor and treatment did not decline.

sentences.zh: 大和二年晉王薨，帝深嗟惜，贈曰悼懷太子。

translations.literal: In the second year of Dahe Prince of Jin died; the emperor deeply lamented and posthumously titled him Crown Prince Daohuai.
translations.idiomatic: In Dahe 2 Prince of Jin died; the emperor deeply lamented and posthumously titled him Crown Prince Daohuai.

sentences.zh: 穆宗貞獻皇后蕭氏，福建人。

translations.literal: Empress Zhenxian of Emperor Muzong, née Xiao, was a native of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Zhenxian of Muzong, née Xiao, came from Fujian.

sentences.zh: 初，入十六宅為建安王侍者，元和四年十月，生文宗皇帝。

translations.literal: At first she entered the Sixteen Residences as attendant to Prince of Jian'an; in the tenth month of the fourth year of Yuanhe she bore Emperor Wenzong.
translations.idiomatic: At first she entered the Sixteen Residences as attendant to Prince of Jian'an; in the tenth month of Yuanhe 4 she bore Emperor Wenzong.

sentences.zh: 寶曆三年正月，敬宗遇弑，中尉王守澄率兵討賊，迎江王即位。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of Baoli Jingzong was assassinated; Lieutenant Wang Shoucheng of the Central Army led troops to punish the villains and welcomed Prince of Jiang to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Baoli 3 Jingzong was assassinated; Lieutenant Wang Shoucheng of the Central Army led troops to punish the villains and welcomed Prince of Jiang to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 文宗踐祚之日，奉冊曰：「嗣皇帝臣名言：古先哲王之有天下也，必以孝敬奉於上，慈惠浹於下，極誠意以厚人倫，思由近以及遠，故自家而刑國。

translations.literal: On the day Wenzong ascended the throne the investiture text read: "The succeeding emperor, your subject [Name], says: When the ancient sage kings possessed all under Heaven, they surely served those above with filial reverence and spread benevolence below, extending utmost sincerity to thicken human relations, thinking from the near to reach the far—therefore from the family they modeled the state.
translations.idiomatic: On the day Wenzong ascended the throne the investiture text read, "The succeeding emperor, your subject [Name], says: When the ancient sage kings possessed all under Heaven, they surely served those above with filial reverence and spread benevolence below, extending utmost sincerity to thicken human relations, thinking from the near to reach the far—therefore from the family they modeled the state.

sentences.zh: 以臣奉嚴慈之訓，承教撫之仁，而長樂尚鬱其鴻名，內朝未崇於正位，則率土臣子，勤勤懇懇，延頸企踵，曷以塞其心乎！

translations.literal: Your subject received stern and compassionate instruction and inherited the grace of nurturing and cherishing; yet Everlasting Joy still lacked its great name and the inner court had not yet honored the formal position—then subjects and sons throughout the realm, earnest and eager, craned their necks and stood on tiptoe; how could that fill their hearts!
translations.idiomatic: Your subject received stern and compassionate instruction and inherited the grace of nurturing and cherishing; yet Everlasting Joy still lacked its great name and the inner court had not yet honored the formal position—then subjects and sons throughout the realm, earnest and eager, craned their necks and stood on tiptoe; how could that fill their hearts!

sentences.zh: 是用特舉彝章，式遵舊典，稽首再拜，謹上穆宗睿文惠孝皇帝妃尊號曰皇太后。

translations.literal: Therefore we specially raise the canonical statute and follow the old canon; bowing the head twice, we respectfully submit the honored title of consort of Emperor Muzong the Sage, Cultured, Gracious, and Filial: Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we specially raise the canonical statute and follow the old canon; bowing the head twice, we respectfully submit the honored title of consort of Emperor Muzong the Sage, Cultured, Gracious, and Filial: Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 伏惟與天合德，義申錫慶，允厘陰教，祗修內則。

translations.literal: We respectfully consider that you accord with Heaven in virtue, righteousness extending granted blessing, truly ordering the feminine teaching and reverently cultivating inner norms.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully consider that you accord with Heaven in virtue, righteousness extending granted blessing, truly ordering the feminine teaching and reverently cultivating inner norms.

sentences.zh: 廣六宮之教，參十亂之功，頤神保和，弘覆萬有。」

translations.literal: Broaden the teaching of the six palaces, share in the merit of the ten disordered, nourish spirit and preserve harmony, and broadly cover the ten thousand beings."
translations.idiomatic: Broaden the teaching of the six palaces, share in the merit of the ten disordered, nourish spirit and preserve harmony, and broadly cover the ten thousand beings."

sentences.zh: 后因亂去鄉里，自入王邸，不通家問，別時父母已喪，有母弟一人。

translations.literal: Because of turmoil the empress dowager left her native place; from entering the princely residence she had no contact with her family; when they parted her parents had already died; she had one younger brother by the same mother.
translations.idiomatic: Because of turmoil the empress dowager left her native place; from entering the princely residence she had no contact with her family; when they parted her parents had already died; she had one younger brother by the same mother.

sentences.zh: 文宗以母族鮮親，惟舅獨存，詔閩、越連率於故里求訪。

translations.literal: Wenzong, because the maternal clan had few kin and only the maternal uncle remained, ordered the governors of Min and Yue to seek him in their native place.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong, because the maternal clan had few kin and only the maternal uncle remained, ordered the governors of Min and Yue to seek him in their native place.

sentences.zh: 有戶部茶綱役人蕭洪，自言有姊流落。

translations.literal: There was Xiao Hong, a tea-transport corvée laborer of the Ministry of Revenue, who said of himself that he had an elder sister who had been lost and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: There was Xiao Hong, a tea-transport corvée laborer of the Ministry of Revenue, who said of himself that he had an elder sister who had been lost and scattered.

sentences.zh: 估人趙縝引洪見後姊徐國夫人女婿呂璋，夫人亦不能省認，俱見太后，嗚咽不自勝。

translations.literal: The merchant Zhao Zhen introduced Hong to Lady of Xu, the empress dowager's elder sister's son-in-law Lü Zhang; the lady also could not recognize him with certainty; both saw the empress dowager and sobbed beyond control.
translations.idiomatic: The merchant Zhao Zhen introduced Hong to Lady of Xu, the empress dowager's elder sister's son-in-law Lü Zhang; the lady also could not recognize him with certainty; both saw the empress dowager and sobbed beyond control.

sentences.zh: 上以為復得元舅，遂拜金吾將軍、檢校戶部尚書、河陽懷節度使，遷檢校左僕射、鄜坊節度使。

translations.literal: The emperor thought he had recovered the true maternal uncle and thereupon appointed him General of the Gold Crow Guard, Acting Minister of Revenue, and Military Governor of Heyang and Huai; he was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director and Military Governor of Fufang.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thought he had recovered the true maternal uncle and thereupon appointed him General of the Gold Crow Guard, Acting Minister of Revenue, and Military Governor of Heyang and Huai; he was transferred to Acting Left Vice Director and Military Governor of Fufang.

sentences.zh: 先是，有自神策兩軍出為方鎮者，軍中多資其行裝，至鎮三倍償之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when men from the two armies of the Divine Strategy went out as regional commanders, the armies often supplied their travel expenses; at the post they repaid threefold.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when men from the two armies of the Divine Strategy went out as regional commanders, the armies often supplied their travel expenses; at the post they repaid threefold.

sentences.zh: 時有自左軍出為鄜坊者，資錢未償而卒於鎮，乃征錢于洪。

translations.literal: At that time one who had gone out from the Left Army to Fufang had not yet repaid the borrowed money when he died in the post; they then collected the money from Hong.
translations.idiomatic: At that time one who had gone out from the Left Army to Fufang had not yet repaid the borrowed money when he died in the post; they then collected the money from Hong.

sentences.zh: 宰相李訓雅知洪詐稱國舅，洪懼，請訓兄仲京為鄜坊從事以彌縫之。

translations.literal: Chancellor Li Xun had long known Hong falsely claimed to be the imperial maternal uncle; Hong feared this and asked Xun's elder brother Zhongjing to serve as aide in Fufang to cover the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Li Xun had long known Hong falsely claimed to be the imperial maternal uncle; Hong feared this and asked Xun's elder brother Zhongjing to serve as aide in Fufang to cover the matter.

sentences.zh: 洪恃與訓交，不與所償；

translations.literal: Hong relied on his friendship with Xun and did not repay what was owed;
translations.idiomatic: Hong relied on his friendship with Xun and did not repay what was owed;

sentences.zh: 又征於卒者之子，洪俾其子接訴于宰相，李訓判絕之。

translations.literal: they again collected from the dead man's son; Hong had his son petition the chancellor; Li Xun rejected the petition.
translations.idiomatic: they again collected from the dead man's son; Hong had his son petition the chancellor; Li Xun rejected the petition.

sentences.zh: 左軍中尉仇士良深銜之。

translations.literal: Lieutenant Qiu Shiliang of the Left Army deeply resented this.
translations.idiomatic: Lieutenant Qiu Shiliang of the Left Army deeply resented this.

sentences.zh: 時有閩人蕭本者，復稱太后弟，士良以本上聞，發洪詐假，自鄜坊追洪下獄，御史台按鞠，具服其偽，詔長流驩州，賜死于路，趙縝、呂璋亦從坐。

translations.literal: At that time Xiao Ben of Min again claimed to be the empress dowager's younger brother; Shiliang reported Ben to the throne and exposed Hong's fraud; Hong was pursued from Fufang and imprisoned; the Censorate investigated and he fully confessed the falsehood; an edict banished him far to Huan Prefecture and he was sentenced to death on the road; Zhao Zhen and Lü Zhang were also implicated.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xiao Ben of Min again claimed to be the empress dowager's younger brother; Shiliang reported Ben to the throne and exposed Hong's fraud; Hong was pursued from Fufang and imprisoned; the Censorate investigated and he fully confessed the falsehood; an edict banished him far to Huan Prefecture and he was sentenced to death on the road; Zhao Zhen and Lü Zhang were also implicated.

sentences.zh: 洪以偽敗，謂本為真，乃拜贊善大夫，賜緋龜，仍追封其曾祖倰為太保，祖聰為太傅，父俊為太師，賜與钜萬計。

translations.literal: Because Hong failed through fraud, they considered Ben true and thereupon appointed him Grand Master of Counselling, granted red robe and turtle insignia, and posthumously enfeoffed his great-grandfather Jun as Grand Tutor, grandfather Cong as Grand Preceptor, and father Jun as Grand Preceptor, with gifts totaling tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hong failed through fraud, they considered Ben true and thereupon appointed him Grand Master of Counselling, granted red robe and turtle insignia, and posthumously enfeoffed his great-grandfather Jun as Grand Tutor, grandfather Cong as Grand Preceptor, and father Jun as Grand Preceptor, with gifts totaling tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 本，福建人，太后有真母弟，孱弱不能自達，本就之，得其家代及內外族屬名諱，復士良保任之，上亦不疑詐妄。

translations.literal: Ben was a native of Fujian; the empress dowager had a true younger brother by the same mother who was frail and could not make himself known; Ben went to him and obtained his family generations and the names and taboo names of inner and outer kin; Shiliang again vouched for him, and the emperor also did not doubt the fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Ben was a native of Fujian; the empress dowager had a true younger brother by the same mother who was frail and could not make himself known; Ben went to him and obtained his family generations and the names and taboo names of inner and outer kin; Shiliang again vouched for him, and the emperor also did not doubt the fraud.

sentences.zh: 本曆衛尉少卿、左金吾將軍。

translations.literal: Ben served as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Left General of the Gold Crow Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ben served as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and Left General of the Gold Crow Guard.

sentences.zh: 開成二年，福建觀察使唐扶奏，得泉州晉江縣令蕭弘狀，自稱是皇太后親弟，送赴闕庭，詔送御史台按問，事皆偽妄，詔逐還本貫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaicheng Military Governor Tang Fu of Fujian Circuit memorialized that he had obtained the petition of Xiao Hong, magistrate of Jinjiang County in Quan Prefecture, who claimed of himself to be the empress dowager's own younger brother; he was sent to the capital court; an edict sent him to the Censorate for investigation; the matter was entirely false; an edict expelled him back to his native district.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaicheng 2 Military Governor Tang Fu of Fujian Circuit memorialized that he had obtained the petition of Xiao Hong, magistrate of Jinjiang County in Quan Prefecture, who claimed of himself to be the empress dowager's own younger brother; he was sent to the capital court; an edict sent him to the Censorate for investigation; the matter was entirely false; an edict expelled him back to his native district.

sentences.zh: 開成四年，昭義節度使劉從諫上章，論蕭本偽稱太后弟，云：「今自上及下，異口同音，皆言蕭弘是真，蕭本是偽。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kaicheng Military Governor Liu Congjian of Zhaoyi Circuit submitted a memorial discussing Xiao Ben's false claim to be the empress dowager's younger brother, saying: "Now from above to below, with one mouth and one voice, all say Xiao Hong is true and Xiao Ben is false.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaicheng 4 Military Governor Liu Congjian of Zhaoyi Circuit submitted a memorial discussing Xiao Ben's false claim to be the empress dowager's younger brother, saying, "Now from above to below, with one mouth and one voice, all say Xiao Hong is true and Xiao Ben is false.

sentences.zh: 請追蕭弘赴闕，與本證明。

translations.literal: We request that Xiao Hong be summoned to court to prove it against Ben.
translations.idiomatic: We request that Xiao Hong be summoned to court to prove it against Ben.

sentences.zh: 若含垢于一時，終取笑於千古。」

translations.literal: If we cover the stain for a time, in the end we will be laughed at for a thousand ages."
translations.idiomatic: If we cover the stain for a time, in the end we will be laughed at for a thousand ages."

sentences.zh: 遂詔御史中丞高元裕、刑部侍郎孫簡、大理卿崔郇三司按弘、本之獄，具，並偽。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict ordered the three offices of Censor-in-Chief Gao Yuanyu, Vice Minister of Justice Sun Jian, and Chief Judge of the Court of Judicial Review Cui Xing to investigate the cases of Hong and Ben; when complete, both were false.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict ordered the three offices of Censor-in-Chief Gao Yuanyu, Vice Minister of Justice Sun Jian, and Chief Judge of the Court of Judicial Review Cui Xing to investigate the cases of Hong and Ben; when complete, both were false.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：

translations.literal: An edict proclaimed:
translations.idiomatic: An edict proclaimed:

sentences.zh: 「恭以皇太后族望，承齊、梁之後，僑寓流滯，久在閩中。

translations.literal: "We respectfully consider that the empress dowager's clan standing, inheriting from Qi and Liang, sojourned and drifted, long in Min.
translations.idiomatic: "We respectfully consider that the empress dowager's clan standing, inheriting from Qi and Liang, sojourned and drifted, long in Min.

sentences.zh: 慶靈鐘集，早歸椒掖，終鮮兄弟，常所咨嗟。

translations.literal: Blessing and spirit gathered early; she returned early to the pepper quarters; she ultimately had few brothers and often sighed over this.
translations.idiomatic: Blessing and spirit gathered early; she returned early to the pepper quarters; she ultimately had few brothers and often sighed over this.

sentences.zh: 朕自臨禦已來，便遣尋訪，冀得諸舅，以慰慈顏。

translations.literal: Since We personally assumed rule We have sent to seek, hoping to obtain the maternal uncles and comfort the compassionate countenance.
translations.idiomatic: Since We personally assumed rule We have sent to seek, hoping to obtain the maternal uncles and comfort the compassionate countenance.

sentences.zh: 而奸濫之徒，探我情抱，因緣州裏之近，附會祖先之名，覬幸我國恩，假託我外族。

translations.literal: Yet treacherous and base men probed Our feelings, using nearness to the prefecture as opportunity and attaching themselves to ancestral names, coveting Our state's grace and falsely borrowing Our outer kin.
translations.idiomatic: Yet treacherous and base men probed Our feelings, using nearness to the prefecture as opportunity and attaching themselves to ancestral names, coveting Our state's grace and falsely borrowing Our outer kin.

sentences.zh: 蕭洪之惡跡未遠，蕭本之覆轍相尋，弘之本末，尤更乖戾。

translations.literal: Xiao Hong's wicked traces are not yet distant; Xiao Ben's overturned cart follows in succession; Hong's and Ben's origins and ends are even more perverse.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hong's wicked traces are not yet distant; Xiao Ben's overturned cart follows in succession; Hong's and Ben's origins and ends are even more perverse.

sentences.zh: 三司推鞫，曾無似是之蹤；

translations.literal: The three offices pushed and interrogated and found not the slightest similar trace;
translations.idiomatic: The three offices pushed and interrogated and found not the slightest similar trace;

sentences.zh: 宰臣參驗，見其難容之狀。

translations.literal: the chancellors jointly examined and saw their unbearable condition.
translations.idiomatic: the chancellors jointly examined and saw their unbearable condition.

sentences.zh: 文款繼入，留中久之。

translations.literal: Written documents entered in succession and were kept within the palace for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Written documents entered in succession and were kept within the palace for a long time.

sentences.zh: 朕于視膳之時，頻有咨稟，恭聞處分，惟在真實。

translations.literal: We at the time of attending to meals repeatedly consulted and reported; We respectfully heard the disposition and that only truth mattered.
translations.idiomatic: We at the time of attending to meals repeatedly consulted and reported; We respectfully heard the disposition and that only truth mattered.

sentences.zh: 丐沐墮桑，既無可驗；

translations.literal: Begging to wash hair and falling mulberry—there was nothing to verify;
translations.idiomatic: Begging to wash hair and falling mulberry—there was nothing to verify;

sentences.zh: 鑿空作偽，豈得更容？

translations.literal: carving emptiness to make falsehood—how could it be further tolerated?
translations.idiomatic: carving emptiness to make falsehood—how could it be further tolerated?

sentences.zh: 據其罪狀，合當極法，尚為含忍，投之荒裔。

translations.literal: According to their crimes they should receive the utmost law; still We showed forbearance and sent them to the wild frontier.
translations.idiomatic: According to their crimes they should receive the utmost law; still We showed forbearance and sent them to the wild frontier.

sentences.zh: 蕭本除名，長流愛州；

translations.literal: Xiao Ben was removed from the registers and banished far to Ai Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Ben was removed from the registers and banished far to Ai Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 蕭弘配流儋州。」

translations.literal: Xiao Hong was assigned to banishment in Dan Prefecture."
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hong was assigned to banishment in Dan Prefecture."

sentences.zh: 初，蕭洪詐稱國舅十數年，兩授旄鉞，寵貴崇於天下。

translations.literal: At first Xiao Hong falsely claimed to be the imperial maternal uncle for more than ten years, twice received the commander's banner and axe, and was honored and exalted throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: At first Xiao Hong falsely claimed to be the imperial maternal uncle for more than ten years, twice received the commander's banner and axe, and was honored and exalted throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 蕭本因士良鄉導，發洪之詐，聯曆顯榮。

translations.literal: Xiao Ben, through Shiliang's guidance from his home district, exposed Hong's fraud and in succession attained conspicuous glory.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Ben, through Shiliang's guidance from his home district, exposed Hong's fraud and in succession attained conspicuous glory.

sentences.zh: 及從諫奏論，偽跡難掩，而太后終不獲真弟。

translations.literal: When Congjian's memorial was submitted the fraud could not be concealed, and yet the empress dowager ultimately did not recover her true younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: When Congjian's memorial was submitted the fraud could not be concealed, and yet the empress dowager ultimately did not recover her true younger brother.

sentences.zh: 文宗孝義天然，大和中，太皇太后居興慶宮，寶曆太后居義安殿，皇太后居大內，時號「三宮太后」。

translations.literal: Wenzong's filial piety was innate; in the Dahe era the Grand Empress Dowager resided at Xingqing Palace, the Empress Dowager of Baoli at Yi'an Hall, and the empress dowager in the Great Inner Palace; at the time they were called the 'Three-Palace Empresses Dowager.'
translations.idiomatic: Wenzong's filial piety was innate; in the Dahe era the Grand Empress Dowager resided at Xingqing Palace, the Empress Dowager of Baoli at Yi'an Hall, and the empress dowager in the Great Inner Palace; at the time they were called the 'Three-Palace Empresses Dowager.'

sentences.zh: 上五日參拜，四節獻賀，皆由復道幸南內，朝臣命婦詣宮門起居，上尤執禮，造次不失。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of each month he paid respects; on the four seasonal celebrations he offered congratulations—all by covered passage to the Southern Inner Palace; court ministers and ladies went to the palace gate to inquire after their well-being; the emperor was especially observant of rite and never failed in haste.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of each month he paid respects; on the four seasonal celebrations he offered congratulations—all by covered passage to the Southern Inner Palace; court ministers and ladies went to the palace gate to inquire after their well-being; the emperor was especially observant of rite and never failed in haste.

sentences.zh: 有司嘗獻新瓜、櫻桃，命獻陵寢宗廟之後，中使分送三宮、十宅。

translations.literal: When offices once presented new melons and cherries, he ordered that after presentation at the tomb shrines and ancestral temples, inner envoys should separately deliver them to the three palaces and the ten residences.
translations.idiomatic: When offices once presented new melons and cherries, he ordered that after presentation at the tomb shrines and ancestral temples, inner envoys should separately deliver them to the three palaces and the ten residences.

sentences.zh: 初，有司送三宮物，一例稱賜。

translations.literal: At first when offices sent goods to the three palaces they uniformly called it 'bestowal.'
translations.idiomatic: At first when offices sent goods to the three palaces they uniformly called it 'bestowal.'

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「物上三宮，安得名賜？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Goods sent up to the three palaces—how can they be named 'bestowal'?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Goods sent up to the three palaces—how can they be named 'bestowal'?"

sentences.zh: 遽取筆塗籍，改「賜」為「奉」。

translations.literal: He immediately took a brush and crossed out the register, changing 'bestowal' to 'presentation.'
translations.idiomatic: He immediately took a brush and crossed out the register, changing 'bestowal' to 'presentation.'

sentences.zh: 開成中正月望夜，帝於咸泰殿陳燈燭，奏《仙韶樂》，三宮太后俱集，奉觴獻壽，如家人禮，諸親王、公主、駙馬、戚屬皆侍宴。

translations.literal: In Kaicheng, on the fifteenth night of the first month, the emperor at Xiantai Hall arrayed lamps and candles and performed the 'Immortal Splendor' music; the three empresses dowager all gathered; they presented cups and offered longevity wishes in the manner of a family; princes, princesses, chief commandants, and kin all attended the feast.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaicheng, on the fifteenth night of the first month, the emperor at Xiantai Hall arrayed lamps and candles and performed the 'Immortal Splendor' music; the three empresses dowager all gathered; they presented cups and offered longevity wishes in the manner of a family; princes, princesses, chief commandants, and kin all attended the feast.

sentences.zh: 上性恭儉，延安公主衣裾寬大，即時遣還，罰駙馬竇浣兩月賜錢。

translations.literal: The emperor's nature was respectful and frugal; Princess Yan'an's skirt hem was too wide and he immediately sent her back, fining Chief Commandant Dou Huan two months' granted money.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's nature was respectful and frugal; Princess Yan'an's skirt hem was too wide and he immediately sent her back, fining Chief Commandant Dou Huan two months' granted money.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，供養彌謹。

translations.literal: When Wuzong ascended the throne his support was ever more careful.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuzong ascended the throne his support was ever more careful.

sentences.zh: 蕭太后徙居積慶殿，號積慶太后。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Xiao moved to Jiqing Hall and was titled Empress Dowager of Jiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Xiao moved to Jiqing Hall and was titled Empress Dowager of Jiqing.

sentences.zh: 會昌中崩，諡曰貞獻。

translations.literal: In Huichang she died; her posthumous title was Zhenxian.
translations.idiomatic: In Huichang she died; her posthumous title was Zhenxian.

sentences.zh: 穆宗宣懿皇后韋氏，武宗昭肅皇帝之母也。

translations.literal: Empress Xuanyi of Emperor Muzong, née Wei, was Emperor Wuzong's mother.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xuanyi of Muzong, née Wei, was Emperor Wuzong's mother.

sentences.zh: 事闕

translations.literal: The record is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The account is missing from the record.

sentences.zh: 武宗王賢妃。

translations.literal: Virtuous Consort Wang of Emperor Wuzong.
translations.idiomatic: Virtuous Consort Wang of Emperor Wuzong.

sentences.zh: 事闕

translations.literal: The record is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The account is missing from the record.

sentences.zh: 宣宗元昭皇后晁氏，懿宗皇帝之母也。

translations.literal: Empress Yuanzhao of Emperor Xuanzong, née Chao, was Emperor Yizong's mother.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Yuanzhao of Xuanzong, née Chao, was Emperor Yizong's mother.

sentences.zh: 事闕

translations.literal: The record is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The account is missing from the record.

sentences.zh: 懿宗惠安皇后王氏，僖宗皇帝之母也。

translations.literal: Empress Huian of Emperor Yizong, née Wang, was Emperor Xizong's mother.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Huian of Yizong, née Wang, was Emperor Xizong's mother.

sentences.zh: 事闕

translations.literal: The record is deficient.
translations.idiomatic: The account is missing from the record.

sentences.zh: 昭宗積善皇后何氏，東蜀人。

translations.literal: Empress Jishan of Emperor Zhaozong, née He, was a native of Eastern Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Jishan of Zhaozong, née He, came from Eastern Shu.

sentences.zh: 入侍壽王邸，婉麗多智，特承恩顧，生德王、輝王。

translations.literal: She entered service in Prince of Shou's residence; graceful and lovely and very clever, she received special favor and bore Prince of De and Prince of Hui.
translations.idiomatic: She entered service in Prince of Shou's residence; graceful and lovely and very clever, she received special favor and bore Prince of De and Prince of Hui.

sentences.zh: 昭宗即位，立為淑妃。

translations.literal: When Zhaozong ascended the throne she was established as Cultivated Consort.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaozong ascended the throne she was established as Cultivated Consort.

sentences.zh: 乾甯中，車駕在華州，冊為皇后。

translations.literal: In Qianning the imperial carriage was at Hua Prefecture and she was invested as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianning the imperial carriage was at Hua Prefecture and she was invested as empress.

sentences.zh: 國家自乾符已後，盜滿天下，妖生九重，宮廟榛蕪，奔播不暇。

translations.literal: From Qianfu onward bandits filled all under Heaven; calamity arose within the nine layers; palace temples were overgrown with weeds and there was no leisure even for flight.
translations.idiomatic: From Qianfu onward bandits filled all under Heaven; calamity arose within the nine layers; palace temples were overgrown with weeds and there was no leisure even for flight.

sentences.zh: 景福之際，奸臣內侮，后於蒙塵薄狩之中，嘗膳禦侮，不離左右。

translations.literal: In the Jingfu period wicked ministers insulted within; amid dust and exile on thin hunts she prepared meals and attended to insult without leaving his side.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingfu period wicked ministers insulted within; amid dust and exile on thin hunts she prepared meals and attended to insult without leaving his side.

sentences.zh: 左關、右輔之幸，時事危迫，後消息撫禦，終獲保全。

translations.literal: When fortune favored the left and right wings the times were urgently perilous; the empress sent word and comforted him and in the end he was preserved whole.
translations.idiomatic: When fortune favored the left and right wings the times were urgently perilous; the empress sent word and comforted him and in the end he was preserved whole.

sentences.zh: 自岐下還京，崔胤盡誅黃門宦官，每宣諭宰臣，但令宮嬪來往。

translations.literal: After returning to the capital from below Qi the court was entirely executed by Cui Yin, who killed the yellow-gate eunuchs; whenever he announced instructions to the chancellors he only had palace women come and go.
translations.idiomatic: After returning to the capital from below Qi the court was entirely executed by Cui Yin, who killed the yellow-gate eunuchs; whenever he announced instructions to the chancellors he only had palace women come and go.

sentences.zh: 是時國命奪於朱氏，左右前後，皆是汴人，宮中動息，雖纖芥必聞于朱全忠。

translations.literal: At that time the nation's mandate was seized by the Zhu clan; those before and behind and at his sides were all men of Bian; within the palace every movement, though fine as a mustard seed, was heard by Zhu Quanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the nation's mandate was seized by the Zhu clan; those before and behind and at his sides were all men of Bian; within the palace every movement, though fine as a mustard seed, was heard by Zhu Quanzhong.

sentences.zh: 宮人常懷惴怵，帝后垂泣相視。

translations.literal: Palace women constantly lived in fear; emperor and empress wept as they looked at each other.
translations.idiomatic: Palace women constantly lived in fear; emperor and empress wept as they looked at each other.

sentences.zh: 天祐初，全忠逼遷輿駕，東幸洛陽。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianyou Quanzhong forced the imperial carriage to move east to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianyou Quanzhong forced the imperial carriage to move east to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 其年八月，昭宗遇弑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year Zhaozong was assassinated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year Zhaozong was assassinated.

sentences.zh: 翌日，宰相柳璨、獨孤損等詐宣皇后令云：「帝為宮人害，輝王祚宜升帝位。」

translations.literal: The next day Chancellors Liu Can and Dugu Sun and others falsely announced the empress's order, saying: "The emperor was harmed by palace women; Prince of Hui's destiny should ascend the imperial throne."
translations.idiomatic: The next day Chancellors Liu Can and Dugu Sun and others falsely announced the empress's order, saying, "The emperor was harmed by palace women; Prince of Hui's destiny should ascend the imperial throne."

sentences.zh: 仍尊后為皇太后。

translations.literal: She was still honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: She was still honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 遭罹變故，迫以凶威，宮中哭泣，不敢聲聞於外。

translations.literal: Having encountered sudden calamity and forced by violent power, within the palace they wept but dared not let the sound be heard outside.
translations.idiomatic: Having encountered sudden calamity and forced by violent power, within the palace they wept but dared not let the sound be heard outside.

sentences.zh: 明年十二月，全忠將僭位，先行九錫，然後受禪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the next year Quanzhong was about to usurp the throne; first he received the nine bestowals, then accepted the abdication.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the next year Quanzhong was about to usurp the throne; first he received the nine bestowals, then accepted the abdication.

sentences.zh: 全忠牙將蔣玄暉在洛陽宮知樞密，與太常卿張廷範私議云：「山西、河北未平，禪代無利，請俟蕩定。」

translations.literal: Quanzhong's bridle-guard officer Jiang Xuanhui, knowing palace secrets in Luoyang, privately discussed with Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhang Tingfan, saying: "Shanxi and Hebei are not yet pacified; usurpation would not be profitable—please wait until all is settled."
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong's bridle-guard officer Jiang Xuanhui, knowing palace secrets in Luoyang, privately discussed with Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Zhang Tingfan, saying, "Shanxi and Hebei are not yet pacified; usurpation would not be profitable—please wait until all is settled."

sentences.zh: 欲有咨諫。

translations.literal: They wished to offer remonstrance and counsel.
translations.idiomatic: They wished to offer remonstrance and counsel.

sentences.zh: 宣徽副使趙殷衡素與張、蔣不協，且欲代知樞密事，因使于梁，誣告云：「玄暉私于何太后，相與盟詛，誓復唐室，不欲王受九錫。」

translations.literal: Deputy Commissioner of the Palace Regalia Zhao Yinheng had long been at odds with Zhang and Jiang and also wished to replace them in knowing palace secrets; he therefore sent an envoy to Liang and falsely reported, saying: "Xuanhui had a private affair with Empress Dowager He, together swore oaths and curses, vowing to restore the Tang house, and did not wish the king to receive the nine bestowals."
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commissioner of the Palace Regalia Zhao Yinheng had long been at odds with Zhang and Jiang and also wished to replace them in knowing palace secrets; he therefore sent an envoy to Liang and falsely reported, saying, "Xuanhui had a private affair with Empress Dowager He, together swore oaths and curses, vowing to restore the Tang house, and did not wish the king to receive the nine bestowals."

sentences.zh: 全忠大怒，即日遣使至洛陽，誅玄暉、廷范、柳璨等，太后亦被害于積善宮，又殺宮人阿秋、阿虔，仍廢太后為庶人。

translations.literal: Quanzhong was greatly enraged; that very day he sent an envoy to Luoyang and executed Xuanhui, Tingfan, Liu Can, and others; the empress dowager was also killed at Jishan Palace; palace women Aqiu and Aqian were also killed; the empress dowager was still demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Quanzhong was greatly enraged; that very day he sent an envoy to Luoyang and executed Xuanhui, Tingfan, Liu Can, and others; the empress dowager was also killed at Jishan Palace; palace women Aqiu and Aqian were also killed; the empress dowager was still demoted to commoner.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：坤德既軌，彤管有煒。

translations.literal: The eulogist says: Once the feminine virtue is aligned, the red record shines bright.
translations.idiomatic: The eulogist says: Once the feminine virtue is aligned, the red record shines bright.

sentences.zh: 韋、武喪邦，毒侔蛇虺。

translations.literal: Wei and Wu ruined the state; their poison matched serpents.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and Wu ruined the state; their poison matched serpents.

sentences.zh: 陰教斯僻，嬪風浸毀。

translations.literal: The feminine teaching turned perverse; consortly wind gradually decayed.
translations.idiomatic: The feminine teaching turned perverse; consortly wind gradually decayed.

sentences.zh: 賢哉長孫，母儀何偉。

translations.literal: How worthy was Lady Changsun; what a grand motherly model!
translations.idiomatic: How worthy was Lady Changsun; what a grand motherly model!
